issuing_body: Japan AI Safety Institute (AI セーフティ・インスティテュート)
covered_actors: AI system development and provision managers (開発・提供管理者)
Third-party red-teaming evaluators (サードパーティ)
AI users/deployers (AI 利用者, as optional reference for procurement)
implementation_notes: Non-binding technical methodology guide (Ver. 1.10, revised March 31, 2025) maintained as a living document by J-AISI to complement its Guide to Evaluation Perspectives on AI Safety. The Ver. 1.10 revision incorporates detailed evaluation items derived from practical red teaming of RAG-based LLM systems and adds multimodal foundation model (e.g., image) attack examples. The guide is organized into a main volume (this document), a detailed explanation annex, and sample deliverables, outlining a 3-stage, 15-step red-teaming lifecycle (planning/preparation, attack planning/execution, and reporting/remediation/follow-up) for both pre-release and ongoing post-deployment testing using automated tools, manual testing, and AI agents.
